title: Chapter 129 Rebuilding The Village
content:
Chapter 129 Rebuilding The Village

In Wang Shuo's tent, after unremitting efforts, he finally learned the manufacturing technology of city wall bricks.

[You have mastered the "city-building bricks" skill through independent learning. 】

Wang Shuo was pleasantly surprised when he heard the system prompt.

He has long known that as a mason, you can learn some new skills on your own, and you can naturally acquire skills through other means.

But this time, obtaining skills is not like before, just a skill scroll can be done. But to learn.

Learn a lot of new knowledge and related operation steps.

This is equivalent to changing from full automation to semi-automation.

He was wondering whether in the future everything would be built by humans and the system would gradually become separated from the manufacturing system?

Maybe it's even possible.

Since I can learn this skill, other masons should be able to do it too.

Wang Shuo quickly summoned the other masons to come over and study together.

An hour later, Wang Shuo discovered two people whose progress in enlightenment was actually comparable to his own.

These two people are called Yan Fujie and Banrick.

The learning effect of others is slightly slower, but it is acceptable.

At this moment, Wang Shuo suddenly frowned and discovered a problem. It seemed that he was not very good at drawing defensive runes in the last step!

But the system did give a system prompt?

Could it be that the "City Building Brick" skill I learned is not a real black iron city brick, but a low-end version without any defensive runes?

At this time, it is not convenient to test, so we can only wait until tomorrow.

Looked at these masons.

Wang Shuo decided to let these 10 masons study overnight so that they could participate in the specific work of firing city wall bricks early tomorrow morning.

After walking out of the tent, Wang Shuo stretched his muscles. After staying in the tent for several hours, he felt a little chest tight.

At this time Suo Yong and Duan Wenxi came over.

"Lord, are you done?" The two looked at Wang Shuo with unnatural expressions.

"Well, what's the matter?" Wang Shuo couldn't understand what the two of them meant.

Duan Wenxi said with a look of helplessness: "Boss, there is something I want to ask you for advice, which is how the newly defected citizens should be treated."

Wang Shuo was also caught in a dilemma for a while.

If the contract scroll is not signed and the other party rebels, there is no risk at all.

Even if there is a contract scroll and no ideological seal is signed, Wang Shuo is a little worried.

"Do you have any suggestions?" Wang Shuo pondered for a moment and said calmly.

"Boss, I just feel that it would be inappropriate for us to confiscate other people's supplies and ask them to sign a contract if they come to join us with good intentions."

"It's really inappropriate." Wang Shuo rubbed his hands. For a while, he couldn't think of a good way.

Wang Shuo turned his head, looked at Suo Yong and asked: "Let me think about this matter. By the way, how is the construction of your house today?"

"Lord, since we have the design drawings, we basically build according to the layout on the drawings."

"The residential houses on the drawing are two-story buildings with 20 rooms each. This kind of house is not only large in capacity, but also beautiful and convenient. It has lighting, toilets and other facilities." Suo Yong became more and more excited as he spoke. , it can be seen that he is very satisfied with this design drawing.

"We have laid the foundation today, and we should be able to build two buildings tomorrow, which can meet the living requirements of 80 people."

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction and looked at Duan Wenxi again.

"Boss, don't worry. I will build your 'Lord's Mansion' beautifully to your satisfaction." Duan Wenxi promised, patting his chest.

"Well, the main thing now is to solve the basic housing problem. The threats we face have not decreased. If we don't free up manpower as soon as possible to build the city wall, it will always make people unable to sleep and eat well!"

"Okay, Lord Lord, I will definitely dedicate manpower as soon as possible to build the city wall."

Ordinary carpenters can also participate in building city walls, but making city wall bricks must be made by masons.

"I hope there will be more people who can make city wall bricks tomorrow!"
